# PureCalculators

> > PureCalculators provides specialized online calculators spanning health, fitness, finance, physics, and everyday utilities with evidence-based formulas from WHO, Harvard Health, and US Navy standards.

The site offers calculators for diverse needs including FIRE retirement planning, CAPM investment analysis, Navy body fat assessment, WHO child growth tracking, and unit conversions. Content is available in multiple languages including Portuguese, serving both professional and personal calculation needs.

## Key Topics

- Health & Medical Calculators
- Fitness & Body Composition
- Financial Independence & Retirement (FIRE)
- Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM)
- WHO Child Growth Standards
- US Navy Body Fat Standards
- Harris-Benedict BMR Formula
- Statistical Analysis (Z-Score)
- Unit Conversion Systems
- Physics & Kinetic Energy
- Probability & Statistics
- Screen Resolution (4K, HD, FHD)
- Portuguese Language Support
- Percentage-Based Calculations
- Evidence-Based Formulas

## Health & Medical Calculators

- [Child Weight Percentile Calculator | Baby Development](https://purecalculators.com/child-weight-percentile-calculator): Baby weight percentile tracker using WHO child growth chart standards
- [Navy Body Fat Calculator | How Much Fat Do I Have?](https://purecalculators.com/navy-body-fat-calculator): US Navy body fat percentage calculator for military fitness standards
- [Calculadora De Pressão Arterial Normal | PureCalculators](https://purecalculators.com/pt/normal-blood-pressure-calculator): Portuguese blood pressure calculator for age-based vital signs (Ryerson)
- [Calculadora Harris-Benedict (BMR) | Encontre Sua Taxa Metabólica Basal](https://purecalculators.com/pt/bmr-calculator): Portuguese BMR calculator using Harris-Benedict and Mifflin-St Jeor formulas
- [Calculadora De Fertilização Na Gravidez | Estimativa De Data De Concepção](https://purecalculators.com/pt/pregnancy-conception-calculator): Portuguese pregnancy conception date estimator based on due date

## Fitness & Exercise Calculators

- [Walked Steps To Miles Calculator | How Many Miles You Walked?](https://purecalculators.com/steps-to-miles-calculator): Convert walked steps to miles for fitness tracking and health monitoring
- [Bench Press Calculator | Find Your 1RM](https://purecalculators.com/bench-press-calculator): Calculate one-rep maximum (1RM) for bench press strength training

## Financial & Investment Calculators

- [FIRE Calculator - Calculate Early Retirement | FIRE Calculator — Financial Independence, Retire Early](https://purecalculators.com/fire-calculator-retire-early): FIRE calculator for Financial Independence Retire Early planning
- [Credit Score Calculator | Credit Score Calculator](https://purecalculators.com/credit-score-calculator): Estimate FICO credit score based on payment history and utilization
- [CAPM Calculator | Capital Asset Pricing Model](https://purecalculators.com/capm-calculator): CAPM calculator for expected return and investment risk analysis
- [Commission Calculator | Percentage-based Remuneration](https://purecalculators.com/commission-calculator): Calculate percentage-based sales commission and remuneration

## Math & Statistics Calculators

- [Probability Calculator | Likelihood Calculator](https://purecalculators.com/probability-calculator): Calculate probability and likelihood for independent/dependent events
- [Calculadora De Pontuação Z (valor Z) | Descubra O Z-score!](https://purecalculators.com/pt/z-score-calculator): Portuguese z-score calculator for statistical analysis and Six Sigma

## Physics & Science Calculators

- [Kinetic Energy Calculator | Calculate The Energy Of Motion!](https://purecalculators.com/kinetic-energy-calculator): Physics calculator for kinetic energy using mass and velocity
- [Calculadora De Volume De Cubo | Fórmula E Resultados](https://purecalculators.com/pt/cube-volume-calculator): Portuguese cube volume calculator using SI/USCS geometric formulas
- [Aquarium Volume Calculator | Calculate The Volume Of Any Tank!](https://purecalculators.com/aquarium-volume-calculator): Fish tank volume calculator using geometric formulas and Pythagorean theorem

## Technology & Utility Calculators

- [Screen Size Calculator | Screen Size Calculator](https://purecalculators.com/screen-size-calculator): Calculate screen dimensions and aspect ratio for 4K, HD, FHD displays
- [Conversão De Milhões Para Lakh | Como Converter Milhões Para Lakhs](https://purecalculators.com/pt/million-to-lakh-calculator): Portuguese converter for millions to lakhs (Indian numbering system)

## Optional

- [Dice Roller | Random Dice Number Generator](https://purecalculators.com/dice-roller): Virtual dice roller for tabletop games like D&D, Monopoly, and Yahtzee
- [Calculadora De Saia Circular | Calculadora De Costura](https://purecalculators.com/pt/circle-skirt-calculator): Portuguese sewing calculator for circular skirt fabric measurements
